_comment: MQTT message-MAC vector for OSPP §5.4. It exists to pin ONE thing that the formula did not say in words until 0.13.0: the HMAC key is the DECODED 32 bytes of sessionKey, not the 44-character Base64 text that carries it on the wire. Both reference implementations already decoded; the spec never said so, and a reader following the formula literally would have produced `macIfKeyNotDecoded` and failed against every conforming peer. Re-check: node tools/verify-mqtt-mac.mjs (also runs as Category 19 of tools/verify-protocol.sh).

key._comment: Deterministic, not random — a vector must be reproducible. Derivation is recorded so the value can be regenerated from nothing but this file.
key.derivation: SHA-256(UTF8("OSPP MQTT MAC test vector v1"))

macIfKeyNotDecoded._comment: NOT a conforming value. This is what HMAC-SHA256 returns when the 44-character Base64 TEXT is passed as the key — the literal reading of the pre-0.13.0 formula. It is recorded so an implementer who computes it can recognise the mistake immediately instead of hunting a canonicalization bug. A verifier MUST assert this differs from `mac`.

producedBy._comment: Four independent oracles agreed on `mac` when this vector was written. The openssl line is the non-circular anchor: it depends on no OSPP code.
producedBy.openssl: openssl dgst -sha256 -mac HMAC -macopt hexkey:923bb0... -binary canonical.txt | base64
